name: 2 m Mall Floor Inside Mitre
summary: A full-depth, inward-facing metal turn for the concave edge of the 2 m mall floor.
description: Two bronze fascia arms face into a missing floor quadrant. Their champagne nosings and narrow bronze inlays meet flush on a 45-degree diagonal. Both square ends connect to the existing 2 m straight trim.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery original procedural modeling
creation_method: The generator appends the original editable straight-edge sections, fasteners and materials, cuts both arms to the inner diagonal, and shares the seventeen seam vertices in one closed body.

dimensions.axis_order: glTF X, Y, Z in metres
dimensions.origin: Re-entrant structural slab corner at finished floor height. The missing quadrant is +X and +Z.

rights: Owner-project reuse of the original geometry, materials and renders is authorized. Public download and redistribution terms are unspecified.
accuracy_notes: Measured decorative floor edge for the 2 m structural kit. The supporting floor remains the native tile footprint. Measurements cover this 90-degree return at unit scale.

attribution.credit: Blender-3D-Gallery authored the original straight floor-edge section, materials and fastener geometry, the fitted inside turn, the editable assembly and the studio render.
